summary.intent: Extract the 5 shared-folder write operations from the useSharedNavigation React hook into stateless SDK functions in a new shared-write.ts module, then refactor the web UI to delegate to the SDK. Also add comprehensive unit tests.
summary.outcome: shared-write.ts was created in packages/sdk/src/share/ with all 5 write handlers plus updateSharePermission, 14 unit tests pass, both sdk and web builds succeed. A follow-on type consolidation pass replaced all inline 'file'|'folder'|'file-ipns'|'folder-ipns' unions with generated api-client types and fixed a dynamic import in shared-write.ts.

repo: The api-client package already has auto-generated key type enums: ShareKeyEntryDtoKeyType ('file'|'folder'|'file-ipns'|'folder-ipns'), ChildKeyDtoKeyType ('file'|'folder'|'file-ipns'), and ShareKeyResponseDtoKeyType — these should be imported instead of using inline unions.

There are 3 semantically distinct key type unions: ShareKeyEntryDtoKeyType (widest, share_keys table), ChildKeyDtoKeyType (create-share DTO), and bare 'file'|'folder' (owner-side re-wrap only — no generated type exists for this).
The SDK previously only covered the owner's write path (shareFolder, revokeShare, reWrapForRecipients). The recipient write path was entirely missing from the SDK prior to this session.
publishSharedFolderMetadata in useSharedNavigation is the recipient-side counterpart to updateFolderMetadataAndPublish in sdk-core — it uses a re-wrapped IPNS key rather than the owner's key.
Quick task IDs use YYMMDD-xxx format with 2-second Base36 precision, stored under .planning/quick/.

code.finding: Defines the widest ShareKeyType union ('file'|'folder'|'file-ipns'|'folder-ipns') — canonical source for this type across SDK and web app
Defines ChildKeyDtoKeyType ('file'|'folder'|'file-ipns') — correct type for createShare child keys, narrower than ShareKeyEntryDtoKeyType
publishSharedFolderMetadata — core building block for all recipient-side write ops; encrypts metadata, uploads to IPFS, publishes IPNS using re-wrapped key
withRevocationGuard — wraps any write operation to detect 403 responses and transition to read-only; not yet extracted to SDK
refreshFolderContents — resolves IPNS, decrypts folder metadata, returns refreshed children + sequence number for shared-folder context; not yet extracted to SDK
create-share DTO uses ChildKeyDto (ChildKeyDtoKeyType), not the wider ShareKeyEntryDtoKeyType — important distinction when typing createShare parameters

workflow: vitest does not support filtering test files by filename using -- syntax directly; use a path glob argument instead (e.g. vitest run packages/sdk/src/share/shared-write.test.ts).
Integration tests that require a live API will always fail in local runs, polluting test output — run targeted unit test files when verifying specific new functionality.
Build both packages (sdk then web) before committing to catch type errors that tests alone won't surface.

When type consolidation causes cascading changes, work outward from the narrowest type (api-client generated types) and be careful to revert widening in places where semantic narrowness is intentional.

friction: Type narrowing required multiple reversal passes — initial changes incorrectly widened 'file'|'folder' to ShareKeyEntryDtoKeyType in owner-side re-wrap code, requiring several read-revert-edit cycles across client.ts, types.ts, and share/index.ts.
The executor used a dynamic import (await import(...)) inside shared-write.ts that had to be manually converted to a static import as a follow-up fix.
vitest integration test failures (no live API) create noise when running the full sdk test suite, making it hard to confirm unit test status at a glance.
The git commit command failed on the first attempt due to running from the wrong working directory, requiring a directory check before retrying.
open_items: withRevocationGuard and isForbiddenError are strong SDK candidates (identified in analysis) but were not extracted — still live only in useSharedNavigation.ts.
refreshFolderContents (useSharedNavigation.ts ~line 254) identified as moderate SDK candidate but not extracted.
restoreIpnsKeyForDepth key-unwrapping logic identified as extractable but not extracted.
The 'after any mutation, re-wrap for recipients' pattern should be baked into the SDK's write path (noted in analysis but deferred).
No generated type covers the bare 'file'|'folder' union used in owner-side re-wrap — either a local type alias should be created or the semantic narrowing should be documented.
E2E / integration tests for shared-write SDK functions require a live API and were not added.
